newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Konsortium says buys 35 pct of Transmile.
newsitem.headline: Konsortium says buys 35 pct of Transmile.

text.p: Malaysian shipping and transport firm Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd said on Monday it planned to acquire a 35 percent stake in air courier Transmile Group Bhd.
Konsortium said it would buy the stake, comprising seven million shares, for 78.75 million ringgit.
In a related statement, Transmile said it would sell a further seven percent stake, comprising 1.4 million shares, to unlisted Prima Paragon Sdn Bhd for 15.75 million ringgit.
Both transactions would be for cash, said Transmile.
Konsortium said the acquisition "will place Konsortium as the largest shareholder of Transmile".
"Konsortium intends to play a more active role in the air logistics segment of the industry, as customers are looking for a multi-modal logistics service provider," said Konsortium.
